title: Repair a CSV parser
specification: Implement function solve(input: string): string[][] for valid CSV. Support quoted commas, doubled quote escapes, CRLF and LF row separators, empty cells, and newlines inside quoted cells. A final row separator does not create an extra row. Empty input returns [[""]]. No imports or exports. Return arrays of strings only. Do not mutate global JSON or host APIs.
